entries.conditions: Weight-only int4 DEQUANTIZE (2-per-byte packed, per-tensor scale) compiles and runs on the Hexagon JIT path. Latency identical to fp32/fp16/int8 twins (4.08 vs 4.07 ms on a 537 MB-parent GEMV chain) — storage dtype does not survive to runtime.

Builtin GELU is the fast exact-GELU spelling on Hexagon: approximate=false 41.9 ms / approximate=true 38.5 ms vs 85.9 ms for the decomposed tanh chain and 89.8 ms for the 96-op chain emitted for torch.erf (same models/probes, N=50 thermal NONE).

evidence.source_model: dinov2_ab_{erf,tanhop} + fx probe family (phase5.log, c0_ab_tanhop.log, phase9.log)

rewrite_hints.rewrite: emit the builtin GELU op; the tanh-chain fusion misses only the coefficient-first association 0.044715*x*x*x (tensorflow#126296)
rewrite_hints.symptom: hand-written tanh-GELU or torch.erf chains run 2-4x slower than the op
